correctness.rationale: The displayed constants are maxima over the specified starts and preferences, not assertions that each profile attains both. Relabeling fixes the first truthful order and preserves adjacency, picking, and gains. An independent replay of all 14,400 report pairs and their eight directed adjacent changes per state found 88,800 unchanged allocations and 26,400 one-for-one exchanges. This proves independence of cardinal magnitudes because the deviator's strict gain is exactly the rank comparison of the two exchanged goods. Topological elimination exhausted all 14,400 states for each of the 120 remaining true orders; longest-path recursion counted arcs, giving 1,584,000 improving arcs in total, no cycles, and maxima 18 and 6. Both are attained: for true orders (01234,01234) one witness starts at (23410,43210), and for true orders (01234,31240) a six-move witness starts at that truthful pair. Each step was checked under the positive utility 5 minus zero-based rank. Exhaustion proves the bounds only for the stated five-good move rule; only maximal sequences terminate at a local equilibrium.
residual_risks: Exact finite enumeration, not a theorem for more goods, unrestricted report changes, or global Nash equilibrium.
